_note: Per-rifle handling. Art: assets/weapons/north_ridge/<id>.glb (rifle sheet kit v2). All fire the shared 'ammo' item. damage is per hit before zone multiplier (old single rifle = 100). cycle_s = time before the next shot. spread = multiplier on the shared hip/aim cone. noise = multiplier on NoiseBus.RADIUS_GUNSHOT. optic = sight on the receiver: type scope (black tube picture, model hidden) | tube_dot (wide tube, red dot) | reflex (model stays, red dot) | iron (model stays); mag = fixed [m] or variable [min, max] true magnification vs the 70 deg hip view; the mouse wheel steps only variable scopes; reticle = duplex | bdc (first-focal-plane holdover for 200/300/400 m from the real ballistics) | dot | none. mag = rounds before a reload. reload = magazine | single.

timber_bolt_carbine.name: Timber Bolt Carbine
timber_bolt_carbine.desc: Green-camo bolt carbine with a short scout scope. Five rounds, slow and sure.

ranger_box_rifle.name: Ranger Hunting Rifle
ranger_box_rifle.desc: Amber-stocked hunting rifle under a long red scope. Four heavy rounds; the deer hunter's choice.

frontier_vented_rifle.name: Frontier Vented Rifle
frontier_vented_rifle.desc: Self-loading rifle with a vented shroud. Ten rounds, quick follow-up shots, lighter hits.

ridge_scout_rifle.name: Ridge Marksman Rifle
ridge_scout_rifle.desc: Long-receiver marksman rifle with a big scope. Accurate at range.

brush_lever_rifle.name: Brush Lever Rifle
brush_lever_rifle.desc: Thumbhole lever gun with a block sight. Six rounds fed one at a time.

north_service_rifle.name: North Service Rifle
north_service_rifle.desc: Lime-stocked service rifle with a red-dot tube. Ten rounds, steady.

compact_patrol_rifle.name: Compact Patrol Carbine
compact_patrol_rifle.desc: Folding-stock carbine. Twenty light rounds, fast handling, short reach.

expedition_rifle.name: Expedition Long Rifle
expedition_rifle.desc: Grey-camo heavy rifle with a large optic and muzzle brake. Five devastating rounds; very loud.
